data.name: Jehu
data.gender_notes: Jehu is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Jehu means 'God is he'. This name is biblically significant as it was the name of a king in Israel who reigned during a time of great turmoil and change. Jehu was chosen by God to lead Israel and bring about judgment and restoration. The name Jehu carries the meaning “God is he” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Jehu usually hope their child will grow to embody god is he and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing God's presence and leadership in one's life.
data.etymology: Jehu belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God is he.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jehu total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_hebrew.name: יהו
in_hebrew.long_meaning: יהו הוא שם עברי שפירושו 'הוא יעשה זאת' או 'אלוהים מושיע'. השם מורכב משתי מילים: 'יה' - קיצור של 'יהוה', שם אלוהים בעברית, ו'הו' - מילה שפירושה 'הוא' או 'קיים'. השם יהו הוא שילוב של שני המרכיבים, שמסמל את האמונה באלוהים כמושיע ופועל בעולם. בתנ'ך, יהו הוא גם שם של מלך ישראל, בן של יהונדב, שמלך בממלכת ישראל במאה ה-9 לפני הספירה.

in_greek.name: Ιηου
in_greek.long_meaning: Ιηου είναι ένα όνομα που προέρχεται από την εβραϊκή γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'αυτός救εί' ή 'Θεόςσῴζει'. Το όνομα αυτό αποτελείται από δύο μέρη: 'Ιη' - συντομογραφία του ονόματος του Θεού 'Ιεχωβά', και 'ου' - που σημαίνει 'αυτός' ή 'υπάρχων'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη και στην πρώιμη Εκκλησία, το όνομα Ιηου χρησιμοποιήθηκε ως σύμβολο της πίστης στον Θεό ως Σωτήρα και Δημιουργό.

in_latin.name: Jehu
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Jehu is derived from the Hebrew language and translates to 'He will save' or 'God saves'. This name is composed of two elements: 'Jeh' - an abbreviation of the divine name 'Jehovah', and 'u' - meaning 'he' or 'existing'. Throughout Christian tradition, Jehu has been recognized as a name symbolizing faith in God as Savior and Redeemer. Historically, Jehu was a king of Israel, son of Jehonadab, who ruled in the 9th century BC.

in_english.name: Jehu
in_english.meaning: God saves, He is the Savior
in_english.long_meaning: The name Jehu originates from Hebrew roots, specifically from the combination of 'Jeh' (a shortened form of 'Jehovah' or 'God') and 'u' (meaning 'he' or 'saves'). Biblically, Jehu was a king of Israel, noted for his actions as described in 2 Kings 9-10. In Christian tradition, the name Jehu signifies faith in God as the ultimate Savior and Redeemer. The name conveys spiritual meaning, emphasizing divine salvation and providence. Personality traits associated with Jehu include leadership, assertiveness, and devotion to faith.

data.cultural_impact: Jehu was a king in the Northern Kingdom of Israel during the 9th century BCE. His reign is marked by his unwavering commitment to serving the Lord and carrying out God's will, despite the political and social upheaval of the time. The name Jehu has since been associated with strong leadership and unwavering devotion to one's cause.
data.spiritual_significance: Jehu's story in the Bible highlights the idea of God's sovereignty and His ability to raise up leaders to execute His will. The name Jehu serves as a reminder of the importance of remaining faithful to God, even in the midst of difficult circumstances and great sacrifices. It is a name that embodies the power and presence of God, and celebrates His faithfulness to His people.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Jehu symbolizes unwavering obedience and commitment to God's commandments. His name means "God is exalted," reflecting his complete surrender to divine will. Jehu's life story serves as an example of faithfulness and determination in carrying out God's mission.

biblical_reference.note: Jehu was a king of Israel, son of Jehonadab, who ruled from approximately 841 to 814 BC.

historical_references.reference: Jehu is mentioned in the Bible as a king of Israel who led a successful rebellion against the Syrian king Hazael.
historical_references.context: Biblical context, specifically in the book of 2 Kings

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Jehu remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.

name_in_real_life.story: Ruth Jehu from Dublin, Ireland embodies the meaning of Jehu - "God is he". Raised in a Christian family, they were taught to honor the significance of their name and walk in faith throughout their life.
